title: The Hangover
draft: Number 1: The Hangover. Imagine waking up in a hotel room in Las Vegas with absolutely no idea how you got there, what you did, or where your clothes went. That is exactly the situation for three friends who realize they've completely blacked out during a bachelor party.

The real chaos kicks in when they realize the groom is missing. They have to piece together the wreckage of the previous night to find him before the wedding starts. It is a hilarious ride because the more they try to figure out what happened, the more ridiculous the evidence becomes.

title: The Conjuring
draft: Number 2: The Conjuring. This movie follows the Perron family after they move into an old farmhouse in Rhode Island. Almost immediately, they start experiencing strange and escalating paranormal events that turn their new home into a nightmare.

To deal with the escalating threat, they call in famous paranormal investigators Ed and Lorraine Warren. If you enjoy horror that builds a sense of dread through a haunted setting, this is a great pick because it focuses on the terrifying reality of a family trapped in a house that feels truly occupied by something malevolent.

title: The Bear
draft: Number 3: The Bear. After leaving the world of fine dining, a talented chef named Carmy returns home to Chicago to take over his late brother’s sandwich shop. It is a complete culture shock. He has to navigate a mountain of debt and a kitchen that is pure chaos, all while trying to manage a staff that is used to doing things their own way.

The tension comes from that constant friction between Carmy's high-pressure standards and the messy reality of a struggling family business. If you enjoy watching characters navigate high-stakes environments where every second counts and the stakes are personal, this is a must-watch.
